instructions.question: What attitude does the poster of this Serbian tweet show: positive (warmth, joy, enthusiasm, upbeat sharing), negative (displeasure, sadness, irony, sarcasm or mockery), or neutral (no evaluative tone)?
instructions.rule: Irony and sarcasm count as negative, even when light and funny. This covers self-mocking jokes about one's own failures or laziness, mock praise, and jokes ridiculing people's habits, the sexes, couples, social media or politicians. Earnest opinions, worries, questions, plain information, plans, aphorisms and neutral banter are neutral. Positive covers clear warmth, laughter, cheering, wishes, compliments, and upbeat shares such as new songs, products, wins or good news. Crime or scandal headlines are negative.

neutral.what: Plain information, routine news, plans, questions, aphorisms, neutral banter and earnest opinions or worries without irony.
examples: Sednica SB UN o Kosovu 10. februara u Njujorku (UN SC session on Kosovo Feb 10 in New York)
Gledacu serije. (I'll watch series.)
Hej drugari u #BIH #sarajevo #Tuzla #demonstracije cuvajte se! Brinem. (Hey friends in BiH, take care! I'm worried.)
neutral.cues: plain statements, jel (is it), dates and times, link-only shares, sincere advice or quotes
neutral.not_for: Ironic or mocking jokes are negative. Enthusiastic sharing is positive.

positive.what: Warmth, joy, enthusiasm, laughter, cheering, greetings, compliments, wishes or daydreams. Also upbeat promotional or good-news shares.
examples: @pUnaVuna jel ti radis ili rtw-ujes :-) Elem, do jaja si :-) (are you working or retweeting :-) anyway, you're awesome)
Uskoro , jos jedna nova pesma ... Puno novosti u narednom periodu , zato pratite nas ... (Soon, another new song... lots of news ahead, so follow us...)
Velečasni @Kole_srb dobio aplauz na izlasku iz tunela #kkcz (Reverend @Kole_srb got applause coming out of the tunnel)
positive.cues: HAHAHA, ajmo (come on), pozdrav (greetings), do jaja (awesome), car (king), nova pesma (new song), uskoro (soon), aplauz (applause), ;) :*
positive.not_for: Mock praise is negative. A plain reply with only a smiley is neutral.

negative.what: Displeasure, boredom, sadness, self-mockery, sarcasm, irony, and ridicule of people, habits, politics or media. Also crime or scandal headlines.
examples: Moje pauze od ucenja traju duze nego samo ucenje (My study breaks last longer than the studying)

Zajednicki fejsbuk profili parova imaju smisla koliko i profili necijeg kera, fetusa ili tek rodjene bebe (Couples' shared Facebook profiles make as much sense as profiles of a dog, a fetus or a newborn)
Mrzim ponedeljak (I hate Monday)
Srpski bokser ubijen zbog ucene (Serbian boxer killed over blackmail)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), najgore (the worst), dosadno (boring), ironic naravno (of course) or da, pametno (yeah, smart), jebi ga (damn), :( , ubijen (killed)
negative.not_for: Affectionate teasing between friends is positive or neutral. Sincere opinions without irony are neutral.
